subject: Vendor lead-time & barbell fulfillment approach for Deal D-2026-045
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: OEM Sales <sales@titan-gpu.com>, SupplyChainOps <procure@supplychainops.com>, CloudPartner Solutions <capacity@cloudpartner.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor lead-time & barbell fulfillment approach for Deal D-2026-045

Team / partners,

Quick summary: Atlas AI (our upcoming Dedicated customer) is aiming for a soft onramp in mid-Oct and steady ramp to full committed tranches by end of Q1. They need a predictable latency SLA and a committed pool for the initial 10k seats. Given current OEM lead-time volatility, I want to propose a barbell fulfillment approach: firm short-term cloud backstop + staggered OEM reservations to lock discounts and priority slots.

Action items we need from each vendor today:
- OEM (Titan): firm lead-time windows for 2 tranche sizes (24x and 48x GPU blocks), current best pricing and any early-payment discounts.
- SupplyChainOps: confirmation of customs/import cushion and ETA variance for shipments (San Jose port / inland transit).
- CloudPartner: ability to hold a 6-week on-demand buffer (warm capacity) and committed burst rates for Oct–Dec.

I've attached the Capacity_Sizing_v3.xlsx with our recommended tranche plan and the deal ramp profile (sheets: summary, weekly-runrate, contingency). Please reply with estimates / redlines by COB PDT tomorrow so we can finalize the mutual action plan for Atlas AI (deal D-2026-045).

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Dedicated Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Capacity_Sizing_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: OEM Sales <sales@titan-gpu.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: SupplyChainOps <procure@supplychainops.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor lead-time & barbell fulfillment approach for Deal D-2026-045

Hi Lauren / team,

Thanks for the detailed plan — appreciate the attached sizing spreadsheet. Quick responses below:

1) Lead times: current quoted manufacturing-to-ship lead-time for our 48x rack units is 14–18 weeks from PO; 24x smaller tranche is 10–12 weeks. These windows assume parts availability remains stable; any change in GPU silicon supply can add 3–6 weeks.

2) Pricing: per-unit GPU MSRP is attached in OEM_Quote_Titan-v2.pdf. For D-2026-045 we can extend a 5% volume discount if Redwood commits to a minimum 6-month staged purchase (signed PO schedule).

3) Priority slot: we can reserve a manufacturing slot within 30 days of a signed commitment (deposit required). Lead-time guarantees require a signed contract with deposit and final spec; otherwise we can offer a best-effort ETA only.

Please confirm which tranche(s) you want to submit as firm POs vs. options. If you want, we can draft a provisional PO schedule for 24/48x tranches to lock pricing and slot.

Regards,
Maya R. (OEM Sales)
Titan Systems — Global Accounts
sales@titan-gpu.com

Attachment: OEM_Quote_Titan-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor lead-time & barbell fulfillment approach for Deal D-2026-045

+1 on the barbell approach. Two practical notes:
- Short term: we should secure a 6–8 week cloud backstop (pay-as-you-go) with a sustained-burst SLA and an escalation path that includes a same-day warm-up for pre-warmed images. That buys us time for OEM lead-time.
- Medium term: split the OEM commitment into three POs: initial 24x to land capacity quickly, second 24x as option (convert within 30 days), final 48x scheduled for Q1. That pattern helps manage cash and gives Titan visibility for sloting.

I'll coordinate procurement language for deposit %, and Vanessa will map customs slack for the Port of Oakland transit.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Capacity Programs | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor lead-time & barbell fulfillment approach for Deal D-2026-045

Folks — added a quick sizing + risk table inline (see below) and attached a cleaned sheet; please ingest into the MA POC. High-level:

- Recommended committed split: 24x firm (deliver Oct), 24x option->confirm in 30 days (deliver Nov–Dec), remaining 48x scheduled for Jan quarter.
- Contingency: require 10% cloud buffer (warm capacity) Oct–Dec; CloudPartner should provide a throttled burst rate guarantee and invoice only on usage beyond the buffer.
- Deposit profile suggestion: 25% on first PO, 15% on options conversion, remainder on ship.

Sizing snippet (simplified):
- Week-of-Oct-11: needed concurrency = 3.5k seats -> maps to 24x (initial).
- Week-of-Nov-01: growth to 6k seats -> convert option 24x if metrics hit 80% utilization.

I'll attach Capacity_Sizing_v3_CLEAN.xlsx (same file uploaded to Drive) for the legal/procurement thread. Marcus, can you confirm customs insurance uplift? Vendor/legal: please flag any clause that blocks a staged PO schedule.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: Capacity_Sizing_v3_CLEAN.xlsx (xlsx)

From: CloudPartner Solutions <capacity@cloudpartner.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor lead-time & barbell fulfillment approach for Deal D-2026-045

Hi Lauren, Ben, Karthik —

We can commit to a 6-week warm buffer for Atlas AI (hold capacity in a warm pool) with the following terms:
- Buffer size: up to 12% of the initial 24x tranche, billed as monthly reservation fee.
- Burst guarantee: up to 2x the buffer rate sustained for 48 consecutive hours; beyond that we will throttle to standard on-demand rates.
- On ramp priority: customers with signed purchase schedule get a priority warm-image boot (estimated warm-up < 3 hours).

We can sign a short addendum to the master cloud SOW. We've attached our Cloud_Backstop_Terms.docx and a preliminary DocuSign envelope to lock the buffer (https://docusign.com/envelopes/EC-45218-AtlasAI).

If you accept the addendum we can hold the buffer slot for 10 business days pending signature.

Best,
Rachel T.
Partnerships — CloudPartner Solutions
capacity@cloudpartner.com

Attachment: Cloud_Backstop_Terms.docx (docx)
